sft.sampling: 4 legacy plus 4 hard, equal EDIT/STOP in each; same stream per seed
sft.trainable: residual link and copied action head

mode_sft.target: EMIT if current greedy action matches any remaining legal edit, or correct STOP; otherwise THINK

rl.reward: 1 for exact+STOP+finite execution, otherwise -1; additional -1 for editing no-op; minus cost_weight*rounds/(9*64)
rl.policy_gradient: on-policy REINFORCE, leave-one-out group baseline, only sampled mode decisions
rl.replay: recorded frozen latent-derived features reused without recomputing or relabeling as sampled tokens

evaluation.selection: report all fixed endpoints, no test or seed selection
evaluation.promotion: no wrong no-op; no loss of parent successes on test and full regression; useful improvement required; default remains parent

scope: bounded RV32 actions serialized as text; not a general language decoder
existing generator families, not real project bugs
reset working state after any code edit; preserve it across THINK steps
no external agent, API training or native binary execution
adaptation of HybridAgent ideas, not paper reproduction
